questions.e: Boal, a Brazilian theatre practitioner, created the Theatre of the Oppressed, which uses theatre to explore social problems. Epic Theatre is Brecht's.

questions.q: Visva-Bharati at Santiniketan, where arts, music and drama have a central place in education, was founded by
questions.e: Tagore founded Visva-Bharati (1921) and held that education should develop creativity and aesthetic sense through the arts.

questions.q: Which of the following is a traditional string puppet form of India?
questions.e: Kathputli of Rajasthan uses string puppets. Tholu Bommalata and Ravanchhaya are shadow puppetry, and Pavakoothu uses glove puppets.

questions.q: In art-integrated learning, art forms are used as a ______ for learning other subjects.
questions.e: Art-integrated learning uses music, drama, visual arts and craft as a vehicle to teach concepts of other subjects.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. Drama in education involves learners in active participation to explore ideas.
II. Drama in education requires every student to perform before a public audience.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Educational drama is a process of learning through enacting and reflecting. It does not depend on a public performance.

questions.q: Kala Utsav, an initiative of the Ministry of Education, aims to promote
o: arts education and artistic talent among school students
sports talent at the national level
questions.e: Kala Utsav was launched to promote arts in education by nurturing and showcasing the artistic talent of school students at the secondary stage.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of using drama in the classroom?
questions.e: Drama is an active method. Passive rote listening is the opposite of what it encourages.

questions.q: A teacher wants students to understand the feelings and motives of a character in a story. Which drama technique suits this best?
o: Hot-seating, where a student answers questions in the role of the character
Memorising the summary of the story
questions.e: In hot-seating a learner takes the role of a character and is questioned by the class. It builds empathy and deeper understanding of the text.

questions.q: In Boal's Forum Theatre, audience members who step in to change the action on stage are called
questions.e: Boal coined 'spect-actors' for spectators who become actors and try alternatives to resolve the problem shown.

questions.q: The Theatre-in-Education (TIE) movement began in 1965 at the
questions.e: TIE started at the Belgrade Theatre in Coventry, England, where actor-teachers presented participatory programmes in schools.
